name: playwright_goto
description: Navigate to a URL and wait for it to load. Returns the final URL, page title, and load status.

name: playwright_get_page_info
description: Load a URL and return its title, current URL, and meta tags (description, og:title, og:image, etc.).

name: playwright_navigate_and_wait
description: Navigate to a URL and wait for a specific element or text to appear before returning.

wait_for_text.description: Text string to wait for in the page body

name: playwright_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of a web page and save it to a file. Supports full-page or viewport screenshots.

selector.description: If set, screenshot just this element

name: playwright_screenshot_element
description: Take a screenshot of a specific page element and save it to a file.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to capture

name: playwright_generate_pdf
description: Render a web page to PDF and save it to a file.

name: playwright_get_text
description: Extract the visible text content from a web page or specific element.

selector.description: Optional: extract text from this element only

name: playwright_get_html
description: Get the HTML source of a page or specific element.

selector.description: Optional: get HTML for this element only

name: playwright_extract_links
description: Extract all hyperlinks from a web page with their text, href, and title attributes.

filter_pattern.description: Optional: only return links containing this string

name: playwright_extract_table
description: Extract a table from a web page as structured data with headers and rows.

index.description: Which table to extract if multiple (0-indexed)

name: playwright_evaluate
description: Execute JavaScript on a web page and return the result.

script.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate (wrapped in a function, must return a value)

name: playwright_click
description: Click an element on a web page identified by CSS selector or visible text.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click

text.description: Visible text of the element to click (alternative to selector)

name: playwright_fill_form
description: Fill in form fields on a web page and optionally submit the form.

fields.description: Object mapping CSS selectors to values (e.g. {'#email': 'user@example.com'})

submit_selector.description: CSS selector of the submit button

name: playwright_type
description: Type text into an input field character by character (more realistic than fill).

name: playwright_select
description: Select an option from a dropdown/select element by value or label.

name: playwright_hover
description: Hover the mouse over an element (useful for revealing tooltips and dropdowns).

name: playwright_press_key
description: Press a keyboard key, optionally focused on a specific element.

key.description: Key to press: Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, etc.

name: playwright_scroll
description: Scroll the page up or down by a specified pixel amount.

name: playwright_wait_for_selector
description: Wait for a CSS selector to appear in a specific state on the page.

name: playwright_wait_for_navigation
description: Navigate to a URL and wait until the specified load event fires.

name: playwright_wait_for_network_idle
description: Navigate to a URL and wait until all network requests have settled.

name: playwright_intercept_requests
description: Load a URL and capture all network requests made by the page.

filter_url_pattern.description: Optional: only capture requests matching this substring

name: playwright_get_response_body
description: Intercept a specific API response body while loading a page.

target_url_pattern.description: URL substring that identifies the API call to capture

name: playwright_mock_route
description: Load a URL with a mocked network route — intercepts requests matching a pattern and returns a custom response.

intercept_pattern.description: URL glob or regex to intercept (e.g. '**/api/users**')

name: playwright_get_cookies
description: Load a URL and return the cookies set by the page.

filter_name.description: Optional: only return cookies with names containing this string

name: playwright_get_local_storage
description: Load a URL and return the contents of localStorage.

name: playwright_get_accessibility_snapshot
description: Get the accessibility tree snapshot of a page or element — useful for a11y audits.

name: playwright_check_aria
description: Extract ARIA roles, labels, and attributes from elements on a page for accessibility auditing.

selector.description: CSS selector for elements to check (default: '[role]')

name: playwright_run_steps
description: Execute a sequence of browser automation steps (click, fill, goto, wait, screenshot, press) in a single browser session.

steps.description: Array of {action, selector?, value?, url?, key?, path?, abort_on_error?} objects

name: playwright_scrape_page
description: SUPER TOOL: Full page scrape — returns page title, full text content, top 50 links, and meta tags in one call.

name: playwright_capture_and_extract
description: SUPER TOOL: Navigate to a URL, take a screenshot, and extract text + headings in one call.

name: playwright_test_form
description: SUPER TOOL: Navigate to a URL, fill form fields, submit, and verify the result — form testing in one call.

success_selector.description: Selector that should appear after successful submission

name: playwright_monitor_element
description: SUPER TOOL: Navigate to a URL and wait for an element to reach a specific state (visible, hidden) within a timeout — returns immediately with found/not-found status.

name: playwright_check_broken_links
description: SUPER TOOL: Load a page, extract all links, and check each one for HTTP errors — returns broken links list.

timeout_per_link.description: Timeout per link check in ms (default 8000)
